# Brand Architecture

Displays WK brand elements and product architecture information.

## When to Use

- Product headers showing brand hierarchy
- Application footers with brand information
- About pages or splash screens

## Jumpstart Implementation

| Jumpstart Component | Description |
|---------------------|-------------|
| `BrandArchitecture` | Brand display component |

For code examples and API details, use the Jumpstart MCP tools:
- `get-jumpstart-components-apis` with `["BrandArchitecture"]`
- `get-jumpstart-components-examples` with `["BrandArchitecture"]`
